question: In an election between two candidates, 90% of the registered voters cast their vote and 18% of the votes polled were found invalid. The winning candidate got 51% of the valid votes and won the election by a margin of 1845 votes. How many voters were registered?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the total registered voters be x.

Valid votes = x × (90/100) × (82/100)

Winning margin = (51% − 49%) = 2% of valid votes

x × (90/100) × (82/100) × (2/100) = 1845

x = (1845 × 1000000) ÷ 14760 = 125000

**∴ The correct answer is 125000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 Total Voters = 100 units
